zh:
The Algorithms - Python


用 Python 实现的算法——用于教学 📚

这些实现仅用于学习。它们的效率可能低于 Python 标准库中的实现，请自行斟酌使用。 ## 🚀 开始使用 📋 参与贡献前，请先阅读我们的[贡献指南](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Python/blob/574d100b7181956e9c8384552fd078165e4cc326/CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 🌐 社区渠道 我们在 [Discord](https://the-algorithms.com/discord) 上！社区渠道适合提出问题并寻求帮助。欢迎加入！ ## 📜 算法列表 请查看[目录](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Python/blob/574d100b7181956e9c8384552fd078165e4cc326/DIRECTORY.md)，方便浏览并全面了解项目。
en:
The Algorithms - Python


All algorithms implemented in Python - for education 📚

Implementations are for learning purposes only. They may be less efficient than the implementations in the Python standard library. Use them at your discretion. ## 🚀 Getting Started 📋 Read through our [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Python/blob/574d100b7181956e9c8384552fd078165e4cc326/CONTRIBUTING.md) before you contribute. ## 🌐 Community Channels We are on [Discord](https://the-algorithms.com/discord)! Community channels are a great way for you to ask questions and get help. Please join us! ## 📜 List of Algorithms See our [directory](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Python/blob/574d100b7181956e9c8384552fd078165e4cc326/DIRECTORY.md) for easier navigation and a better overview of the project.
